title: Detailed candle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='wax' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#e8d8b0'/>
      <stop offset='0.35' stop-color='#fff6d8'/>
      <stop offset='0.7' stop-color='#f0e2b8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#cdb888'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='waxTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fffbe8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e6d2a4'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='flameOuter' cx='0.5' cy='0.6' r='0.5'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffd84d'/>
      <stop offset='0.55' stop-color='#ff9a2e'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff6a1f'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='flameInner' cx='0.5' cy='0.65' r='0.5'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#fff3a8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffd23a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='0.5' cy='0.5' r='0.5'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffcc44' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='0.6' stop-color='#ff8c2a' stop-opacity='0.22'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff8c2a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='candleStick' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#7a5a2a'/>
      <stop offset='0.3' stop-color='#e0b45a'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#ffe08a'/>
      <stop offset='0.75' stop-color='#d4a13c'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#6b4c20'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='drip' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fff6d8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f0e2b8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- warm glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='34' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- drip on left -->
  <path d='M32 58 q-2 8 1 12 q2 3 4 0 q2 -3 1 -12 z' fill='url(#drip)'/>
  <!-- drip on right -->
  <path d='M66 60 q2 7 0 11 q-1 3 -3 1 q-2 -2 -1 -12 z' fill='#f4e6c0'/>

  <!-- candle body -->
  <rect x='30' y='48' width='40' height='40' rx='4' fill='url(#wax)'/>
  <!-- body shading side -->
  <rect x='62' y='50' width='7' height='36' rx='2' fill='#d6bf8e' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- subtle vertical highlight -->
  <rect x='38' y='52' width='5' height='32' rx='2' fill='#fffbe8' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- wax top rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='20' ry='7' fill='url(#waxTop)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='20' ry='7' fill='none' stroke='#c9b07c' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- melted pool around wick -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='9' ry='3.5' fill='#fffdf0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='9' ry='3.5' fill='none' stroke='#e6cf98' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- wick -->
  <path d='M50 47 q1 -4 0 -6' stroke='#5a4630' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- flame outer -->
  <path d='M50 14 q7 9 7 16 q0 8 -7 11 q-7 -3 -7 -11 q0 -7 7 -16 z' fill='url(#flameOuter)'/>
  <!-- flame inner -->
  <path d='M50 24 q4 6 4 10 q0 4 -4 6 q-4 -2 -4 -6 q0 -4 4 -10 z' fill='url(#flameInner)'/>
  <!-- flame highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- decorative band on candle -->
  <rect x='30' y='72' width='40' height='3' fill='#e0b45a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='30' y='78' width='40' height='1.5' fill='#e0b45a' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- holder base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='22' ry='6' fill='url(#candleStick)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='22' ry='6' fill='none' stroke='#4a3414' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='15' ry='4' fill='#8a6428'/>
</svg>
